verdict.reason: File directly confirms the error. The grammar_note at line 236 states "세미콜론 병렬 (보어 대조)" (semicolon parallel - complement contrast), explicitly documenting that the elements are complements. However, the segments data tags both "not louder shouting" and "simply better building" with role="M" (modifier) at lines 220-222 and 232-234 respectively, when they should be role="C" (complement). This is a clear internal contradiction: the grammar analysis correctly identifies the construction as complement contrast, but the structural role assignments are wrong. In the pattern "S + is + complement", both post-copular elements must be complements (보어), not modifiers.
